name: HOB Co.,Ltd.
summary: HOB Co.,Ltd. produces and sells seedlings and strawberries in Japan. The company also engages in the retail and wholesale of vegetables; and fruits, such as blueberries, mango, and kiwifruit. In addition, it imports and exports crops, fruits, and vegetables; and sells and rents agricultural equipment, materials, etc. Further, the company produces and sells seed potatoes; and purchases and sells fruit potatoes. Additionally, it offers transport and handling services for fruits and vegetables. HOB Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Kamikawa, Japan.
